description: This file contains utility functions for resolving media understanding parameters such as timeouts, prompts, model entries, capabilities, and scope decisions within a media understanding module. It also manages configuration retrieval and fallback logic for media models.

methods.name: resolveTimeoutMs
methods.description: Calculates timeout in milliseconds based on optional seconds input, with a fallback value.

methods.name: resolvePrompt
methods.description: Generates a prompt string, appending character limit instructions if applicable.

methods.name: resolveMaxChars
methods.description: Determines maximum character count for a media understanding capability based on configuration hierarchy.

methods.name: resolveMaxBytes
methods.description: Determines maximum byte size for a media understanding capability based on configuration hierarchy.

methods.name: resolveCapabilityConfig
methods.description: Retrieves media understanding configuration for a specific capability.

methods.name: resolveScopeDecision
methods.description: Decides whether to allow or deny media understanding based on scope and context.

methods.name: resolveModelEntries
methods.description: Resolves applicable media model configurations for a given capability, considering shared and specific models.

methods.name: resolveConcurrency
methods.description: Determines concurrency level for media processing based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveEntriesWithActiveFallback
methods.description: Provides media model entries, falling back to active provider/model if no specific entries are found.
